summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Rulers
summary.text: Catalog entries for astrological questions on rulers, succession, dreams, travel, borrowing, partnerships, victory and defeat, royal appointments, letters, runaways, writing, digging, and marriage, with cross-references to Venetian codices and Hephestion of Thebes. Leo the Philosopher’s material on kings, rulers, and the turning of affairs is noted as edited in the appendix.
